scopeChoices.value: Подтверждены готовый совместимый проём и отверстия, готовый кабель и отключающее устройство, доступ с пола, пригодность оснащения и точное соответствие жал PH1 и SL1,5 крепежу и клеммам

scopeChoices.titleRu: Условия среды и начальная пригодность измерительного поста
scopeChoices.value: Сухое помещение +1…+40 °C, влажность не более 70 %, высота не более 2000 м; указатель и согласованный проверочный прибор исправны, осмотрены, с пригодным начальным питанием и действующими документами; ремонт и обновление питания не требуются

sourceScope: DEMO conditions are authored project method assumptions, not captured site facts. No defaults or old estimate migration.
Quiet100 plain220–240V50Hz ClassII only; exact existing shaft/opening, no new duct, no connection fittings BOM invented.
Existing prepared compatible cable and all-pole isolation, proven before contact; no live work, no new cable selection or strip-length invented.

Ground-level access; no drilling/cutting, no external vehicle or storage/lifting work in this explicit branch. Manual handling must be suitable for actual confirmed unit mass/packaging and manufacturer instructions; otherwise this branch is not applicable.
Actual fit of PH1 and SL1.5 must be confirmed; source physical availability does not prove screw/terminal fit. Own PPE specification and actual accepted test programme must be documented.
Initial tool post usable with current documents and power; battery renewal, tool maintenance and periodic testing are outside this installation scope, not unconditional extra stages.
If further statutory tests, lifting devices, new holes/duct/line, waste or transport are required, this reference scope is inapplicable until those real needs are separately authored.

Operating environment is the exact intersection of selected fan and matched proving-unit limits: dry indoors,+1..+40C,max70%RH,up to2000m. Primary tool sources remain authority, not the older erroneous locator glyph.
The ready all-pole isolator must have an actually compatible individual lock. The lock is a separate own PROJECT_SYSTEM physical need; it is not supplied by VIPD150-S.
Voltage indicator maximum ON30s, OFF240s or8:1 duty; proving unit output/cycle restrictions from exact manuals remain applicable procedural limits, never a test-count/battery-consumption norm.

Mechanical protective gloves are not claimed to be dielectric PPE. No live work is permitted. Any further PPE or statutory test requirements invalidate this narrow demo scope until separately authored.

После восстановления крышек питание включено штатным аппаратом; вентилятор запускается и работает без задевания, посторонних предметов и выявленных повреждений.
